Anna: Heads up — thinking about adding a searchable saved-queries panel at the top of the per-route view. Want this to support per-model and cross-model scopes, plus a cost/telemetry preview when you pick one. Thoughts?
Miguel: Nice. Two quick questions: how do we define scope (route, model, org, shared)? and how do we surface quota impact before apply?
Anna: Scope options: Route / Model / Team / Org. Default to Route for UX simplicity. Quota preview should show estimated tokens/hour and cost delta.
Jess: Backend note — saved queries are currently keyed by project_id + owner_id. To support multi-scope we need to add a scope enum and a canonical resource id column. That's a DB migration but straightforward.
Sam: UX idea: single search box with a scope pill dropdown on the left. Keyboard nav, fuzzy match, and a small cost chip on each result like "~$0.12/hr". If user is on a dedicated plan show exact reserved-cost estimate.
Miguel: For telemetry preview, we can reuse the existing telemetry-explorer sampling API (v2) but we need an aggregated lookahead: given query filters, estimate token distribution over next 1h. That requires route-specific sample rates.
Jess: Agreed. Implementation plan: 1) add scope to saved_queries table, 2) new read endpoint GET /api/saved_queries?scope=route&model=gpt-x&query=..., 3) augmented result includes cost_preview and telemetry_preview fields. Example response snippet: 
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "scope": "route",
  "cost_preview": "0.12/hr",
  "telemetry_preview": {"est_tokens_per_min": 45}
}
```
Miguel: Minor API debate: should cost_preview be computed server-side or returned as a token-estimate and let client compute cost (bc pricing differs per customer)? I'm leaning server-side per-customer call so it respects pricing tier.
Sam: Client compute would be faster and allow instant filtering, but server-side ensures accuracy. Could do hybrid: return token_estimate + optional customer_cost if customer_id provided.
Anna: Hybrid sounds good. We'll do token_estimate always and customer_cost when auth header present. Default UI shows token_estimate and a "Calculate cost" button for exact.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "searchable-savedqueries" created (off). Rolling to staging 10%. :rocket:
Jess: Rollout notes — enable flag and incremental DB migration. Migration must backfill existing saved queries to scope=route. Backfill script should run in batches.
Miguel: Telemetry side: add route_sample_rate metadata to the route config so the telemetry preview can be weighted properly. Also add a fallback sample_rate.
Sam: UX rollout: start with power users opt-in -> staged to 10% orgs -> 50% -> full. Add a banner in console when feature-flag is on explaining scope defaults and cost preview.
Anna: Action items: Miguel -> telemetry sample rate change, Jess -> DB migration + endpoints, Sam -> mockups + keyboard interactions, I'll own rollout doc and product message. Can we get estimates?
Jess: DB + endpoint: 3 days dev + 1 day testing. Backfill script 1 day.
Miguel: Telemetry change: 2 days dev + 1 day testing. Need to coordinate with telemetry infra to add per-route metadata.
Sam: Mockups and prototype: 2 days. I'll post designs in #design later today.
Anna: Great. I'll open a GH epic and set the feature-flag to staging once infra-bot confirms staging deploy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
